spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Three great and distinct excellences were opened in the first human state, and by them it stood above every combined power acting in the inner and outer degrees.

First, the Divine likeness was impressed upon that first state. Those who ordered its outward form fixed it according to the radiant pattern shown to their higher perception. Therefore that first state appeared in a beauty surpassing any unified power in the higher and lower domains.

Second, that first state was arranged in its whole constitution by the illumination of primary truth proceeding from the inmost heaven, together with a sufficient fullness of operative powers. Therefore its constitution differed from all other formed states, because each order of life has its own distinct arrangement. In that first state the inmost life was fitted to a right ordering of fundamental receptive qualities, and so it possessed an understanding surpassing that of other formed lives and their lower affections.

Third, within it were gathered the teachings, the directing perceptions, and the conjoining fixation of all powers acting from within and from without. Those who arranged that state collected these things and made them permanent within it. That first human state, together with its paired reception of life, became a containing form for the complete ordering of recurrent changes and all measured variations of state, from the greater to the lesser and back again. Thus the full order of the whole domain was stamped upon the first human state. Therefore the inner and outer degrees were stirred because of it, and contention and disturbance arose on its account between goods and evils: goods drew it toward living conjunction because the Divine likeness and form had been set within it, while evils drew it toward spiritual death so that they might rule through it, establish dominion, and by means of it abase the entire order.

Further, it is to be understood that ruling evils determined and arranged that first human state so that they might become masters through it and establish dominion, and they did this for a full series of purposes.

The first purpose was that it might become the source of illumination for their own formed states, in place of the higher illumination of Divine mediation previously shown to their perception; for they all longed for that likeness, and their will was drawn toward it.

The second was that they might draw down wisdom through that first state and hold it bound, preventing its return to higher degrees.

The third was that, by means of the likeness of Divine mediation impressed upon that first state, everything of the Divine in inner and outer degrees might be brought into contempt, because the splendour of that likeness appeared in a superior beauty, and that first state outshone all other formed lives.

The fourth was that it might be a conjoining fixation and a fresh determination, so that all later human states brought forth might come into existence in the same general form.

The fifth was that through it all the abilities of the powers acting within and without—those hidden and those openly operative—might be displayed, and that they might set the measure of their whole reach by it, so that each thing would stand revealed within that human form.

The sixth was that through the Divine likeness placed upon it there would come to be a great safeguarding for them, because heavenly order would restrain even ruling evils, and no evil would be inflicted upon them on account of that first state.

The seventh was that it might become chief and ruling over all formed lives, and that they might establish dominion through it.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coheres strongly as a single spiritual account: the first human state is described as uniquely stamped with Divine likeness, ordered by higher truth and operative powers, and made a container for universal order; then the voice shifts to the opposite intention—ruling evils exploiting that same form for dominion. The only strain is in the protection clause (¶12), which requires careful opposite-sense handling to keep the logic consistent.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential teaching: Adam is treated as a functional “seal”/container in which cosmic order and conflict become readable. No narrative seams; the spiritual reading arises directly from what Adam *is and does* (image-bearing, structural ordering, containing cycles), not from jurisdictional administration.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function and organic consequence: “The image…was placed upon him…sealed him” (¶3) → likeness as formative principle; “shaped…through the light…[and] the five sons…fits over the correct distribution of the elements” (¶4) → intelligence arises from right elemental distribution; “became a dwelling and home for the signs…stars…months…days…years…For the seal of the entire universe is stamped upon Adam” (¶5) → Adam as container/measure of cycles; then functional consequence: “heaven and earth moved because of him…trouble…between…good…evil” (¶5). The spiritual reading’s handling of zodiac/months as ‘ordered cycles and measured state-changes’ matches the text’s container/seal logic and does not require forcing beyond the normal abstraction of correspondential reading.

findings.diagnosis: Clean seam/transition, but not a corrupt one: it marks a rhetorical pivot from Adam’s excellences (three things) to the rulers’ *intention* (seven reasons). The voice stays largely correspondential (purposes expressed as effects/functions), though the opening phrase introduces a governance-flavored frame (“rulers…masters…conceive the kingdom”). This is a legitimate shift rather than an insertion.
findings.evidence: The paragraph is a hinge: “Furthermore, understand that the rulers determined and formed Adam so that they would be masters through him and conceive the kingdom because of seven things.” (¶6). The spiritual reading flags it as “SHIFTS,” which is accurate, but the subsequent list explains *why* Adam functions as a tool (illumination, scooping up light, propagation of births, etc.), so the narrative continues rather than breaks. The ‘rulers/masters/kingdom’ diction is administrative-leaning, but it immediately serves a functional teleology (purposes), not a roster of offices.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential purpose-list (teleological expansion) rather than an administrative overlay: the seven items explain functional exploits of Adam’s stamped image (illumination-substitute, capture/obstruction of ascent, humiliation via beauty, replication by seal, display/revelation of powers, kingship). No extraneous named authorities or territorial jurisdictions; the list participates in the story introduced in ¶6.
findings.evidence: Each item teaches by function/operation: “became the enlightener…instead of the light of the image of the Ambassador” (¶7); “scoop up the light…restrain and obstruct it from its ascent” (¶8); “image…humiliated…because…splendour…beauty…superior” (¶9); “seal-ring…impression…all births…after his seal” (¶10); “displayed…all the skil[ls]…determine…every thing be revealed in him” (¶11); “chief and king…over all creatures” (¶13). The spiritual reading does not report any non-participating names or list-like jurisdictions; it reads smoothly as motives/functions, which is the correspondential signature.

findings.diagnosis: Local logical/grammatical difficulty (likely damage or awkward transmission), not an insertion. The clause conflicts with the list’s premise (rulers exploit Adam for dominion) by adding that Adam’s image provides “great protection for them” and that “the heavenly would restrain even rulers,” producing the exact ‘opposite-sense’ strain noted by the spiritual reading. This is best explained as a corrupted/elliptical line (or a missing referent), rather than a different administrative layer: it lacks jurisdictional inventory and stays within the same topic (effects of the image).
findings.evidence: Problem text: “That there would come to be a great protection for them through the image…; for as the heavenly would [restrain] even rulers; and no evil thing would be done to them on account of Adam.” (¶12). The spiritual reading explicitly reports: “required an opposite-sense reading to keep coherence.” That stumble is caused by internal contradiction: the ‘rulers’ are the exploiters in ¶6–¶11, yet ¶12 makes Adam’s image a protective mechanism benefiting “them” and invokes ‘heavenly restraining rulers,’ which either flips agents/patients or compresses a more nuanced claim (e.g., protection of the rulers from other evils; or protection of Adam/humans from the rulers). The bracketed restoration “[restrain]” and the comparative “as the heavenly would…” signal a fragile line where a small corruption (pronoun antecedent, missing negation, or omitted object such as ‘them from’) would force the reader into opposite-sense harmonization.

textual_criticism.summary: 4 findings: (1) ¶2–¶5 confirms a clean correspondential substrate; (2) ¶6 is a legitimate hinge with minor governance diction (mixed) but no insertion; (3) ¶7–¶11,¶13 are a coherent functional purpose-list, not an administrative overlay; (4) ¶12 is a genuine local difficulty/damage point causing the only noted stumble. Recommendations: excise 0, annotate 0, none 4.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Three great things that are distinct were revealed in Adam the first human. Indeed, due to this, he was found to be better and more outstanding than the conjoined powers that are in heaven and on earth.

The first: The image of the exalted one was placed upon him. The creators and moulders of his body sealed him after the shining form of the image that had been displayed to them above. Indeed, due to this, the image of Adam was found to be surpassingly beautiful beyond any conjoined power above and below.

The second thing: Adam was shaped in his structure through the light of the first-born of heaven and [earth, through] the five sons. Indeed, due to this, his structure was found to differ from the structure of even the other creations; [sin]ce the form of all creations is different. As for Adam, the formation of his soul fits over the correct distribution of the elements. Therefore, he has intelligence surpassing that of the other creations and beasts.

The third are the teachings and counsels and the seal of all the powers above and below. The creators, who set him in order, gathered them and sealed them in him. Adam and his consort Eve became a dwelling and home for the signs of the zodiac and the stars; and the months, the days and the years. For the seal of the entire universe is stamped upon Adam. Indeed, due to this, heaven and earth moved because of him; trouble and disorder arose on his account between they that are good and they that are evil. So, the good induce him to life because of their image and shape placed upon him; while the [wi]cked were drawing him to death, so that they would have power through him and they would conceive the kingdom, and through him humiliate the entire universe.
Furthermore, understand that the rulers determined and formed Adam so that they would be masters through him and conceive the kingdom because of seven things.

⟨p.158⟩
The first: He became the enlightener in their creation; instead of the light of the image of the Ambassador who had displayed himself to them above. For they all desired the likeness of the image of the Ambassador. Their heart was drawn after it.
The second: So that they would scoop up the light through him and restrain and obstruct it from its ascent to the heights.

The third: So that because of the image of the Ambassador that is placed upon him the entirety of the divine that is above and below would be humiliated; on account of the likeness of the splendour, of the beauty of his superiority. For he is superior in his appearance to all creatures.
The fourth: He is a seal-ring and a new impression, so that all births who will be begotten might be brought forth after his seal.

The fifth: That might be displayed through him all the skil[ls] of the powers, they above and below, secret and manifest; and that they might determine through him the totality, and every thing be revealed in him.

The sixth: That there would come to be a great protection for them through the image of the exalted one that was placed upon him; for as the heavenly would [restrain] even rulers; and no evil thing would be done to them on account of Adam.
The seventh: That he might become chief and king and master over all creatures; and they might conceive the kingdom through him.
